chung.Syllabus Name: Meta social media marketing Management_Quản trị chiến dịch tiếp thị truyền thông xã hội toàn diện
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h online + 3h offline + 1h Final exam + 101 self-study
chung.Description: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to digital marketing, with a particular focus on major social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and others. It aims to equip students with the fundamental knowledge, skills, and tools required to build and grow engaging online communities, as well as to strategically develop and successfully execute effective social media advertising campaigns.
chung.StudentTasks:
1. Join the online course(s) when being invited by the admin.
2. Enroll in the courses., regularly study the course at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required
3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct
4. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)
5. Communicate and discuss in forum
6. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional)
7. Must complete the course(s) with certification(s) in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
chung.Note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
2) Theoretical Exam (TE)
3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus)
4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

clo: Analyze social media and advertising metrics to inform data-driven decisions and campaign improvement.
Develop audience-focused social media strategies to build engagement, community growth, and platform presence across major social media channels.
Design targeted social media advertising campaigns to achieve specified marketing objectives.
Create engaging social media content that aligns with brand identity, communication goals, and platform requirements.
Demonstrate self-directed learning and adaptability in response to changes in social media technologies, platforms, and practices.
